# Third-party front-end files (stored locally so the app works offline)

| Folder | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bootstrap/` | Bootstrap (CSS + bundle JS) | 5.3.8 | MIT — https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/main/LICENSE |
| `bootstrap-icons/` | Bootstrap Icons | 1.13.2 | MIT — https://github.com/twbs/icons/blob/main/LICENSE |
| `chartjs/` | Chart.js (UMD build) | 4.6.1 | MIT — https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/blob/master/LICENSE.md |
| `qrcode-generator/` | qrcode-generator by Kazuhiko Arase (`qrcode.js`, unmodified, npm 1.4.4) | 1.4.4 | MIT — notice kept in the file header |
| `fonts/` | Mukta, Baloo 2 (Ek Type), via @fontsource | — | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

These files are committed on purpose (they used to be caught by a too-broad `vendor/` rule in `.gitignore`).
